LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING FLUENCY: POEM

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we display appropriate expressions when reading a text? 2. How can we ensure that we read at the right speed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify techniques of reading fast,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

● Self- efficacy: The learner fluently reads given poems.

Social justice: The learner reads poems focusing on social issues.
